launches.title: Goldbridge – Ramp for Real Estate 🏠
launches.tagline: The all-in-one financial platform for real estate owners. Banking + intelligence + automation, custom-built for property owners & operators.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** We can increase a real estate owner’s property values by 20 percent in less than three months. We already have thousands of units on board and just signed a strategic partnership deal with a company that puts us in front of 8M units in 2026.

We’re [Alvin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alvinsalehi/) & [Greg](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gregrami/) and we’re the founders of [Goldbridge](https://www.goldbridgebanking.com/). Alvin’s first YC company, Shef (W19), is a homemade food marketplace that helped change state laws across the country so that people could legally cook and sell food from home. They raised over $100M, scaled Shef nationally, and built it into a Series B company that continues to grow rapidly across the country.

Now we’re building Goldbridge, the financial operating system for real estate – and we built it from the ground up based on our personal experience owning and operating residential properties.

**THE PROBLEM**

Over **$1 trillion** **of rent** flows through landlords’ bank accounts every year, and nearly 25% of it sits idle in reserves and deposits. In other words, **real estate banking is fundamentally broken**:

* Traditional banks don’t understand real estate cashflows
* Property management systems don’t handle money movement, treasury, or yield
* Operators juggle multiple bank accounts, spreadsheets, and manual reconciliations
* Billions are lost every year in missed yield, overpayments, and operational inefficiencies

This is one of the largest underserved financial categories in the country.

**WHY WE BUILT GOLDBRIDGE**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95598&key=user_uploads/95578/286eb9a4-254e-43a5-b09c-1e451fbb85ce)

As the son of immigrants, Alvin grew up in a motel and helped his parents manage properties growing up. Now he owns 81 units in the Bay Area, and he’s personally experienced how painful it is to manage property finances once you hit mid-market scale (50+ units).

By modernizing his banking stack, renegotiating contracts, appealing his property tax bills, applying for government rebates, optimizing maintenance spend, and restructuring rent collections, Alvin took his 81-unit portfolio from **–2% burn → +36% cashflow in just a few months.**

We’ve now replicated this for other property owners, and the patterns are universal.

**OUR SOLUTION**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95598&key=user_uploads/95578/de43ac4b-4268-4af9-8522-7410002f340c)

**1. Banking Built for Real Estate**

launches.body:
<https://partner.starlightcharging.com>

Hey everyone - this is Andrew with [Starlight Charging](http://partner.starlightcharging.com/).

**tl;dr** EV charging stations are a great opportunity for generating passive income, once the stations are installed. We [built tools](https://partner.starlightcharging.com) to help you launch and scale your EV charging business – everything from site analysis and installation management (through our national network of certified electrical contractors) to payment collection.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87003&key=user_uploads/157923/54fdff9a-ce05-4576-aa6f-2e7f72d01086)

<https://youtu.be/RHqxOSwp-VU>

### **Problem:**

The US needs 100x more EV charging stations to be installed in the next 10 years if gasoline cars will be replaced by EVs. Rather than leaving this work up to the oil companies, who will drag their feet, we think blitzscaling charging needs to be done right, and done soon. 

As with most real estate, not all locations are created equal. It’s hard to predict which potential installation sites will see high utilization and profitability. What’s more, running an installation process in commercial environments (like multifamily apartment buildings or condos) is complicated and overwhelming.

### **Our Solution:**

 We are empowering the hard-working electricians of the world to not only solve the charging gap, but also be financially rewarded for doing so. We built magical software that can help analyze millions of candidate charging station locations for profitability, and manage the installation process – everything from permitting and contracts to material and labor management. We built integrations with over 30 different EVSE manufacturers, so that you can operate different charging station models all from one dashboard.  

After installation, operating a charging station business does require some ongoing work – stations need to be regularly inspected, updated, and retail prices need to be adjusted for fluctuations in energy prices.  Starlight’s all-in-one platform streamlines this part of the business for you.  Just like a vending machine, as people use your charging stations, you’ll collect small amounts of revenue day-after-day.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87003&key=user_uploads/157923/0f3aa3f4-742c-4b3c-ba9c-92a4882d5d23)

**How did we get here?**\
We have spent several years honing our own EV charging station operation through [Starlight Charging](http://www.starlightcharging.com/) – we have installed and operate ports all across the country. Through this process, we not only built custom software, but we discovered that electricians are in a unique position to profitably install and run the charging stations themselves.

**Why Electricians?**

First, a large majority of the installation cost is labor. Electricians can install stations during off-peak times, meaning they’ll keep their team busy now, investing in recurring revenue for later. Next, unlike nontechnical folk, electricians understand how these systems operate – it’s their bread and butter. Finally, if a charging station goes offline and needs maintenance, a locally-based station owner can get them repaired sooner – the incentives to keep the stations operating reliably are aligned!

**Our Ask:**

[CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP](http://partner.starlightcharging.com/)  for our Pro plan to get started immediately on building your own EVSE network. We’re giving the first 15 electricians who sign up an extra 15 charging stations under management for free with the purchase of our “Pro” plan. 

_P.S. If you’d like to start operating your own EV charging station network, please _[_get in touch_](https://mailto:info@starlightcharging.com)_ with us! Even if you are not an electrician, we’d be interested in hearing how we might be able to tailor the partner program to you._

launches.tagline: Catch drawing & spec issues before they cost you money.
launches.body:
## We’re launching an **AI agent for Construction Drawings Review**. It automatically scans drawings, specs and building codes to catch issues _before_ they turn into rework, delays, lawsuits, and margin erosion.

### **The Problem**

Every construction project is slowed down by drawings mistakes:

* Building code violations
* Dimensions that don’t match between structural, architectural, civil, MEP drawings
* Materials mismatch for doors, windows, cabinets etc.
* Ownership/responsibility confusion

These inconsistencies cause rework, schedule delays, and frustrated clients. They happen on **every project**, and can cost **6-7 figures per job**. 

Humans aren’t the best to check hundreds or thousands of pages.

### **Our Solution**

An AI agent analyzes all project documents, architectural / structural / civil / MEP drawings, project specifications, and building codes, and flag issues like dimension mismatches, materials mismatches, ownership/responsibility confusion, missing info, ADA/code red flags, and uncoordinated addenda.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95694&key=user_uploads/1753502/f4847fca-af87-4839-91bf-d3059e73674d)

It’s simple: you upload your project documents in PDF. DONE. AI will prepare the issues list that is easy to review in our web app.

No workflow change. No training. Just fewer errors and better margins.

We’re already running our agent on Tenant Improvement, K-12, civic, industrial, healthcare, affordable housing, and residential projects.

It recently saved a GC $2M in rework for a $100M project due to a material mismatch.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mm24TApb8bg

launches.tagline: SchemeFlow uses generative AI to draft the technical reports required for construction projects
launches.body:
[SchemeFlow uses generative AI to draft the technical reports required for construction projects](https://youtu.be/yLDCATCbWog)

* Getting housing and infrastructure built takes FAR TOO LONG in the developed world today. YEARS are taken up in approvals and technical work before work on site can begin.
* Environmental impact assessments, traffic impact studies, acoustics, geotechnical, flood risk reports, applications for federal grant funding. The list goes on…
* Our technology drafts these reports in minutes rather than months, allowing technical professionals to focus on the big picture.
* Helping to draft these reports quickly and accurately reduces the attack surface for NIMBYs & opponents of projects to slow down or stop projects from getting built.
* We HAVE to tackle this problem to restore prosperity and dynamism to our towns and cities. LET'S GET BUILDING!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81424&key=user_uploads/652482/6e2e0a62-9b4b-4149-b771-9cedaf8c5f05)

_Elon vs. the environmental technical reports for the Tesla Gigafactory in Berlin_\
\
**WHO ARE WE?**

We’re two brothers and a friend from high school in Birmingham in the UK, who started SchemeFlow because of their frustration with how long it takes to get construction projects underway.

* [Andrew Browning](https://www.linkedin.com/in/browningandrew/) (CEO): Chief of Staff to the Mayor for four years, helping secure a 10x increase in capital funding for transport infrastructure projects. Hugely frustrated with the speed of local projects like the Dudley Metro transit project (first proposal 1984, construction 2020, completion date 2025!) and the paperwork required to get construction started.
* [Jonny Browning](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jonnybrowning/) (CTO): Software engineer specialising in the application of AI / ML in existing industries. Previously at Red Hat and Datatonic (European Data & ML consultancy) working on ML platforms for major UK companies such as Vodafone and BT.
* [James Griffith](https://www.linkedin.com/in/griffithjames/) (COO): Structural engineer in the Advanced Technology Group at engineering firm Arup, licensed in the UK and California. Designed the tallest tower of the Sagrada Familia in Barcelona (the tallest church in the world, accelerating construction speed by 10x) and led the earthquake-resistant glass rebuild of the iconic Museum of Anthropology in Vancouver, BC (making it survive a "once in a millennia" earthquake).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81424&key=user_uploads/652482/d8676569-8b48-40cf-a8ce-44a777dd6968)

_Start a company with your brother: good idea? We’ll find out soon enough..._\
\
**OUR TECH**

**Structured Report Generation Platform**

* We allow technical consultants to quickly draft these reports in minutes rather than months.
* Insert technical analysis quickly and easily into their reports, removing the need for complex third-party software tools for many projects (e.g., GIS platforms).
* Access via web app or in Microsoft Word (which is where these consultants live!).

**Combination of LLMs and Structured Technical Data**

* LLMs to generate a first version, with the ability to quickly tweak and redraft.
* Use LLMs on top of technical data & analysis, which is known to be accurate.
* Tight control of LLMs & prompts (low temperature) to prevent hallucination. [Read this post](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/cowboys-norfolk-broads-ai-prompts-transport-future-andrew-browning-krykc/?trackingId=PR19RAt%2Fd5FuHXZe76G30Q%3D%3D) if you’re interested in what we’ve found using LLMs for technical text generation.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81424&key=user_uploads/652482/02a5d922-75e1-48f9-90a5-b53b4773ce34)

_Future of document review: Click, click, click, and choose the version you like best?_\
\
**Add New Structured Reports Quickly and Easily**

* Consultants can use their own existing templates, or we can work with them to generate and enhance templates based on previous reports.
* Internal tagging tools to speed up our onboarding of new reports and disciplines to the SchemeFlow platform

**ASK OF YOU**

* **Book a demo** [here](https://www.schemeflow.com/book-call) if you’re an engineer or built environment professional
* **Forward this as a link** to an engineer or built environment professional you know
* **Follow us** on [LinkedIn!](https://www.linkedin.com/company/schemeflow/)

Propaya uses AI to automate commercial lease abstractions and reviews, enabling real estate professionals to distill complex lease data into actionable insights. Propaya customers save 90% of lease review processing time and cost compared to before.

Managing commercial real estate leases is a complex, time-intensive, and error-prone process. Each lease often runs dozens of pages, filled with intricate clauses that require meticulous review. Traditional manual methods slow operations and increase the risk of errors, leading to financial losses, missed opportunities, and legal disputes.

**The Numbers Tell the Story:**

* **Time-Consuming Processes:** Manual lease reviews are labor-intensive, with automation capable of reducing review time by 90%.
* **Prevalence of Errors:** 78% of companies have errors in their lease data due to outdated information, underscoring the critical need for regular data updates.
* **Financial Impact:** On average, businesses lose $15 million each year due to hidden commercial lease costs like overlooked clauses and inaccuracies.

**The Business Opportunity:** The lease abstraction service market is booming, valued at $4.48 billion in 2024 and projected to grow to $5.92 billion by 2028, at a CAGR of 7.2%. launches.title: Karmen: The AI Assistant for Construction Project Managers
launches.tagline: Spend less time in your inbox.
launches.body:
### 

### **TL;DR**

Karmen is an **AI assistant** for **construction project managers**, helping them save time by automating admin tasks like **invoice approvals, RFI management,** and **change order tracking**. By linking directly to emails and texts, Karmen captures and organizes project updates, letting owners and general contractors automate time-consuming documentation tasks. Project managers can **save around 3 hours per day** from searching through 100s of emails and uploading to multiple construction management tools such as Procore.

### **The Problem: Project Managers Spend Hours on their Emails**

Construction project managers receive hundreds of emails daily, many from subcontractors. These emails often include:

* **Invoices**: Billing for completed work or materials.
* **RFIs (Requests for Information)**: Requests for clarification on project details or specifications.
* **Change Orders**: Requests for modifications that impact project scope, schedule, or cost.

Subcontractors often send emails or texts and are reluctant to adopt construction management software to submit these requests. As a result, project managers spend hours reading emails and entering data into platforms such as Procore.

### **The Solution: Automate these Tedious Tasks with AI**

Karmen lets project managers link their emails and construction management software (e.g. Procore) to do the following:

* **Data Entry**: Automating the manual process of entering details from correspondence, such as invoices.
* **Project Matching**: Match emails to the relevant project and subcontractor.
* **Real-time Updates**: Notify project managers of subcontractor updates that may affect the project schedule scope. i.e. a potential change order.

### **Demo**

<https://youtu.be/YtrQeMM5Yps>

### **About Us**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85372&key=user_uploads/2190507/ccc2d86b-7c9a-4c1e-9af4-00f660cc63c4)

Jonas managed logistics as a **commodity trader at IXM**. Also, growing up, he worked for his parents, who were general contractors in London.\

If you (or someone you know) are a project manager, [book a demo](https://calendly.com/jonasebrahimi-karmenai) or reach out to [jonas@karmenai.com](https://jonas@karmenai.com) or [naman@karmenai.com](https://naman@karmenai.com).\

launches.body:
We’re Arvind and Akhil, and we’re building [Fresco](https://fresco-ai.com/).

### TL;DR

Fresco is a scribe for construction superintendents, helping them create 1000s of pages of documentation 10x faster. We free up time for supes to do what matters most: keep projects on time and under budget.

### The Problem: Documentation sucks

Imagine spending half your work day doing your actual job…and the other half _just writing down_ what you did. That’s the reality for 210k+ construction superintendents (or supervisors, foremen, PMs, etc.) across the USA. 

Project management tools like Procore and ACC have dramatically increased documentation requirements: supes are spending up to 3 hours a day creating documents for compliance, regulation, and to keep various stakeholders informed. This is on top of their actual job, which is to quarterback construction projects and manage safety, quality, timelines, and more.

**Fresco creates documents in minutes, not hours.** By the time supes walk back to their trailers at the end of the day, all of their documents are already waiting for them.

### The Solution: AI scribe

Today, most supes already walk around job sites with their phones, taking photos or brief videos to capture problems or observations on site. But, at the end of the day, they do the very manual work of matching photos with their paper notes to create detailed “punch lists” or logs.

In Fresco, supes simply narrate over videos they take on site. For example, they might point the camera at a corroded beam and say something like “The beam in the southwest corner of room 134 is corroded and needs replacement by Alex.” Fresco pulls out this action item along with a picture of the beam so Alex can get the job done. **Supes who use Fresco complete their notes, on average, 90% faster.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85005&key=user_uploads/210149/97e3a8cb-bacc-4f5e-847f-63832a6fc08a)

In this video, you can see how a supe and a project manager voice over a school refit we worked on. **Normally, creating the final report takes 2+ hours. Fresco uses the info captured on the walkthrough and creates the report in less than a minute.**

<https://youtu.be/LOu3g9A6P2w> 

Fresco offers one-click integrations with Procore and ACC, so if supes need to enter their data there, they can easily do this without ever leaving Fresco. We’ve worked on sites that are using _both_ Procore and ACC, and Fresco saves supes hours they’d otherwise spend double-entering notes.

### About Us

[Arvind](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arvindveluvali/) - I got my BA + MS from Brown, and started my career in synthetic biology at NASA. After starting and selling a political tech company, I dove into the startup world, first in VC, then product, and most recently in sales + ops at an AI company.

[Akhil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/akhil-climate/) - I received my BA + MA from Johns Hopkins, and worked on generative AI “before it was cool” at MIT and various startups. After using AI for ads safety at TikTok, I spent the last 18 months building software for commercial solar at Lumen Energy.

### Our Ask

* TRY: If you’re interested in trying Fresco for yourself, please reach out to [akhil@fresco-ai.com](mailto:akhil@fresco-ai.com). We love getting feedback from our users, and discovering new ways that they get value from Fresco.
* INTRODUCE: General contractors here in the Bay Area. We’re getting feedback from GCs using our product in the field, but most of them aren’t local. We’re looking to work with a local firm like **Skyline Construction, Cahill Contractors, Build Group, or Plant Construction**, to ride shotgun as they use Fresco in the field. If you have an intro, please reach out to [arvind@fresco-ai.com.](mailto:arvind@fresco-ai.com)

# **tl;dr**

Bild AI reads construction blueprints and extracts material and cost data for builders. Our software automates the $50B/year spent on manual blueprint processing. Watch our demo [here.](https://youtu.be/Brj5QnphFxg)

# **The Problem**

Working with construction blueprints to get material and cost estimates is a manual process, involving drawing on blueprints by hand. This is time-consuming and prone to human error, which can lead to tens of thousands of dollars in losses per project. It bottlenecks builders and suppliers from winning new contracts as they’re bogged down with the tedious process of bidding. There are massive manual estimation and bidding teams in-house and outsourced.

# **Our Solution**

We're bringing construction blueprints into the present with artificial intelligence. Bild AI ingests blueprint files and applies computer vision models and large language models to calculate detailed material quantity and cost estimates for flooring, doors, hardware and more. Our first clients are using Bild AI to bid on 10x more projects, with confidence in the accuracy of the estimates. This is just one application of blueprint processing that our clients use today, but our vision extends to permitting and architecture checks.

They are exited founders applying their experience to automate blueprint analysis—helping builders focus on what matters: building.

launches.title: 👥 Second – The second developer bot you've always wanted
launches.tagline: Bots that set up web applications, add features, and keep projects up to date
launches.body:
TL;DR: Instead of hiring a second developer, use a bot to handle developer grunt work and common features so that your human developers can work on more important things.

Hi there! My name is Eric Rowell. I’m the founder and CEO of Second, which provides bots that can set up web applications, add common features, and keep projects up to date.

👉 [Click here to see the product demo video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IR9JUxznEC0)

### The Problem

Let’s face it. No developer wakes up in the morning and thinks to themselves “Gosh, I can’t wait to build yet another login and user registration flow!”. Or “You know what, I’m really excited to migrate MUI from version 4 to 5!”.

Boilerplates? They suck. You spend hours searching for something that’s close to what you want, and then days hacking at it to get it into shape. After the dust settles, you’ll eventually wonder if it was even worth it.

The overarching theme here is that developers are spending way too much time building commodity features and doing grunt work. This reduces their overall happiness (no, really!) and it slows down product delivery. What if bots could handle the common stuff?

### The Solution

Second provides bots that specialize in commodity feature development, like authentication, login screens, user registration, subscription billing, dashboards, navigation, forgot password flows, CRUD forms, etc., and also provides bots that can do more sophisticated things like upgrade libraries or frameworks. Best of all, this value is delivered as well written source code in the form of Git pull requests! No abstractions, DSLs, or other weird stuff to learn.

How is this possible? Users install Second Bot on their GitHub account. These bots operate in the cloud, and use a custom built codegen engine which writes out code files line by line, and will also utilize GPT-3 for special scenarios like code injection and merge conflict resolution.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69533&key=user_uploads/602008/c04a0a9f-f829-4c75-99bc-dc35995ca66d)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69533&key=user_uploads/602008/f71c9851-8e34-4d22-9730-ad004c787510)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69533&key=user_uploads/602008/85589f57-a9f9-425c-a5fa-d84f29b678a6)

### Backstory

I’ve been building for the web for over a decade, including developing the Yahoo video player, architecting the LinkedIn homepage, and leading data visualization efforts at Workday. I’ve created several popular open source projects like KineticJS, BigOCheatSheet, and El Grapho. Most recently I was the co-founder and CTO of Uiflow (W21) which is a no-code platform for enterprise.

While at Uiflow, I built a high-fidelity web authoring experience like Webflow and a custom-built visual language called Flowlang. Among many reasons, including the realization that modern approaches to no-code and low-code platforms for web application construction are still not viable, I made the difficult decision to leave Uiflow and start over.

In all of this time, I have seen how web application development has actually become more complex over time. I’ve seen all kinds of approaches to simplify the process, including an explosion of new libraries, frameworks, languages, DSLs, no-code tools, and low-code tools. After departing Uiflow and spending two months on discovery, the idea of Second began to emerge. What if bots could just write code and raise pull requests for the common stuff? Is that crazy? Well, yea. Let’s do it!

To my amazement, I was accepted back into YC for a second chance, based on nothing more than some insights and an idea!

### My Ask

My ask is really simple! Sign up and try Second for free! ([www.second.dev](http://www.second.dev)). I would love to hear your thoughts. You can use the Quick Start to set up a Next.js + MUI web application fast!

If you want access to the Pro modules, please contact me and I can set that up for you!

👉 You can find me on Twitter at <https://twitter.com/ericdrowell>

👉 Or you can join the conversation on the Second Community Discord – <https://www.discord.gg/ZhYUEjsW3Z>

Hi!

We’re [Jesse](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jc10/) and [Gautham](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gautham-ramachandran-74b5712a4/), and we’re building [Bidflow](https://usebidflow.com/) to help electricians bid on more jobs. Ask: Do you know any electrical contractors? If so, introduce us at [founders@tryghostship.dev](mailto:founders@tryghostship.dev) or [book a demo with us](https://calendly.com/jessechoe10/demo-with-bidflow).

# The Problem

Electrical estimating - the process of figuring out how much an electrical construction project will cost is super tedious and can take anywhere from a few hours to months. Imagine reading through 500-page PDFs, counting hundreds of small symbols per page on 50 pages of complicated circuits, and manually entering thousands of numbers on slow, legacy software.

Electrical estimators do this process everyday but manually, and most of the time, they lose the job by a small margin. Estimating is the only way electrical contractors make revenue, and they do it manually because one mistake can cost thousands of dollars and they need to be careful!

# Our Solution

Because estimating is such a careful process, electrical contractors still do everything manually, especially because AI is hard to trust. That’s why we built Bidflow - an AI copilot for electrical estimating that serves as an assistant not a replacement.

Bidflow is designed with context to think like an electrician and most importantly, show the estimator “proof of work”, turning the estimators job more into reviewing the AI’s mistakes. We’re able to process all of your project documents and save you time in reading through hundreds of pages of fine print.

Bidflow also has the same features as the legacy softwares these estimators use, but it combines everything together, making it an all-in-one platform that also saves estimators time switching between the softwares.

We decided to target electrical contractors because we both have family in the industry who’ve complained about how slow work has been. We then decided to go door-to-door in the Bay Area and got our first design partner.

launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Structured AI is building the **AI workforce for construction design engineering**, starting with AI agents that perform quality control on technical documents and drawings. Our agents learn your standards, apply the right building codes, and **automatically review your drawings**, so you see fewer clashes, fewer inconsistencies, and fewer costly RFIs and change orders.

* ⚙️ **Automates QA/QC** across mechanical, electrical, structural and more
* 🧩 Used by **multi-disciplinary design firms** to deliver projects faster with less risk
* 🚀 **Mission:** Free engineers to focus on creative design, not repetitive admin

Launch Video: https://youtu.be/CRFsqOTynng

### **❌ The Problem**

The construction industry's reliance on manual "spot-checking" for design errors costs **$177 billion** annually to fix mistakes that are discovered too late.

Senior Engineers spend up to **50%** of their time cross-referencing 100-page drawing sets against 2,000-page building regulations by hand. This process is slow, tedious, and unreliable.

Errors that are missed become exponentially more expensive to correct once construction is underway, causing massive project delays and budget overruns.

---

### **⚙️ The Solution**

Structured AI is the **AI Quality Assurance platform.**

1. **Proprietary Vision & Agents:** We trained a foundational vision model on **thousands** of engineering symbols to read plans like an expert.
2. **100x Faster, 150% More Errors:** Our AI checks 100-page blueprints against 2,000 pages of building codes **in minutes.**
3. **Cross-trade Checks:** Learns firm standards to detect inconsistencies across documents, drawings and Revit models, reducing cross-trade clashes before they occur.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94607&key=user_uploads/1527607/252c0ccd-bd5b-4118-b05f-1f9767d981a6)


---

### **👷‍♀️ The Team**

The team is made up of **Oxford University–trained AI researchers** with deep experience building software tools for AEC and enterprise automation, having developed and scaled in-house AI tools at **Syska Hennessy Group**, a top US MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) engineering firm. 

* **Brandon (CTO):** Authored papers for **NeurIPS** and **ChromaDB** (reviewed by Stanford's AI Lab) and created the first open-source **RAG chunking evaluation** framework.
* **Raymond (CEO):** Built automation at **Goldman Sachs** and the **London Stock Exchange**; implemented an AI system at a £1B VC that increased deal flow 20×.
* **Issy (COO):** First undergrad Director at Oxford's VC Fund, led investments later backed by a16z and Tim Draper; previously investment banking at **Greenhill.**

### **🏗️ Why Construction Engineering?**

Brandon started coding and making games when he was 12. At 17, a YouTube video he made demonstrating a fighter jet trained with deep reinforcement learning to dodge missiles went viral. This led to him being scouted by a US construction contractor to apply that same algorithm to MEP pipe routing optimization. He then spent the next six years, throughout high school and university, contracting and building AI tools for the construction and engineering industry. He later led innovation and scaled AI tools in-house at a top US engineering firm, ultimately spinning out with his team to form Structured AI.

Raymond initially pursued architecture and engineering, but was talked out of the profession during an internship. Junior architects warned him about the extensive manual "grunt work" that defined their roles, a prospect that deterred him so much he switched his studies to Maths & Stats at Oxford. He now views his work freeing engineers from these very tasks as a full-circle moment, allowing them to focus on their passions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94607&key=user_uploads/1527607/1e2f9415-f8f3-419c-92d8-0e007f9919b9)

---

### **🙏 Our Ask**

If you lead **mechanical, electrical, civil, or structural design teams** and want to automate documentation or QA workflows, we’d love to show you Structured AI.

👉 Book a call: https://www.getstructured.ai/ 

📩 Contact: [info@getstructured.ai](mailto:info@getstructured.ai)

launches.title: Brickwise - AI Property Manager 🏡
launches.tagline: Automating maintenance for landlords and property managers
launches.body:
Hey everyone[ 👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)

We’re[ Ismail](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeilani) &[ Elias](https://www.linkedin.com/in/eliaskassell/?miniProfileUrn=urn%3Ali%3Afs_miniProfile%3AACoAABeEg0EB4O6J8hjKE8dqLAnLjFXI3sosGQs) - co-founders of[ Brickwise](https://www.brickwiseai.com).

# **TL;DR**

**Brickwise is building an AI property manager that automates maintenance for landlords and property managers.**

Landlords usually get into property as a way to make money. They quickly realise it requires a lot of work, so they hand things over to property managers. On average, 1 property manager is hired for every 120 properties. That’s just the cost of property management.

Brickwise is making it possible to deliver profits and margins that haven’t been possible pre-AI.

Our Launch Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aDJyMnw8jpE

**Ask:** Are you a landlord or property manager? Or, do you know landlords or property managers? I’d love to speak to them directly: [ismail@brickwiseai.com](mailto:ismail@brickwiseai.com)

---

# **Problem ❌**

There are 240,000 property management firms in the US. They spend \~$56bn per year on salaries to manage properties. This reality is true pretty much everywhere in the world. In Europe, 214,000 firms spend \~$35bn on salaries.

How are these salaries financed? On average, an owner has to pay 10% of their monthly rent (before mortgages, taxes, repairs) to property managers.

This represents half the problem (literally). 50% of landlords are so put off by the cost of using a property manager, they choose to manage it themselves.

Unfortunately, this just hasn’t been solvable before. The more properties you have, the more people you need. One person can only answer so many emails or respond to so many calls.

As a team, we’ve been there before, building a small property management firm overseeing 130 properties. We understand the nuances of managing properties, from maintenance issues to evictions.

We also understand why only now technology has made it possible to change this.

# **Solution ✅**

Brickwise will one day automate the entire property lifecycle. We’re starting by making the most labour-intensive part as automated as possible: maintenance.

**Part 1 - 24/7 support via call, email and text**

Tenants are given a phone number and email that they can contact 24/7 (you can also try it yourself!)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95234&key=user_uploads/190230/ef9b52f3-74fb-4132-a7ac-b10c4fc328b7)

Our AI agent does more than just triage and arrange visits. It actually understands issues and suggests fixes on the spot.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95234&key=user_uploads/190230/106cee28-b84f-49cb-ac19-ecfc8c643333)

**Part 2 - Organising and arranging contractors**

Of course, not all issues can be resolved over call or text. Often, someone needs to take a look. This usually involves a series of phone calls between the property manager, the tenant and the contractor. When you’re managing thousands of properties, resolutions take time. Reasons include (but are not limited to):

* Someone’s out of office
* You’ve been assigned a new property manager
* The contractor didn’t pick up their phone (and your property manager forgot to call back)
* It’s a weekend and your issue isn’t urgent
* They’re getting multiple quotes because the repair is expensive

Whatever the reason, everyone is unhappy when things take long. The beauty of AI is its ability to speak to many people at the same time. This means as soon as our agent picks up an issue, it is able to contact dozens of contractors (external or internal) at the same time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95234&key=user_uploads/190230/f8bbbc58-1056-4271-a561-5c56357a6f7b)

**Part 3 - Keeping everyone updated, like “real life read receipts”**

Property managers are always kept in the loop with everything the agent is doing, giving them the exact oversight they need. At the same time, tenants are always updated with how things are progressing. These systems are automated, and most importantly scalable. We can manage instant updates for thousands of tenants.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95234&key=user_uploads/190230/065b1dd8-e4e4-42f8-aee2-5be5f1c1facb)

# Ask 💬

If you are, or you know any of the following, I’d love to hear from you:

**Property Managers**\
You’re probably managing hundreds or thousands of properties and are figuring out if this AI thing makes any sense for you. Is it as good as it sounds? Does it integrate into my current PMS?

**Landlords**\
You might be a professional landlord, or you might be a software engineer running the family property business on the side. You’d rather not, but there’s no one else that’s able to do it.

You can reach out to us at [ismail@brickwiseai.com](mailto:ismail@brickwiseai.com)

# Team

Ismail is an ex-Googler and previously the founder of LiveLink, an AI video editing platform that edited 150k videos per month for over 1000 customers. They raised $3m. He also ran his own property business helping oversee 130 properties.

Elias was an early engineer at Dataform (YC W18) who were acquired by Google. At Google he worked in the core team that grew Dataform’s revenue at Google from 0 to $100m in 4 years. He left Google to create Busbysims, a platform for engineers to design systems, before starting Brickwise.

Fun fact: Elias was the only member of the Dataform team who did NOT want to take the acquisition!

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Appraisals have always been the bottleneck in mortgage underwriting, Automax will appraise any home in just **20 minutes**, fully compliant & with more transparency and data driven insights.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-M8BFckrxyk

Hey I’m Humza, Founder of Automax 👋

For the last 40 years, my family has been in the appraisal business. Automax first started as internal tooling to automate their manual Excel and report processes. That side project grew to power **3,000+ reports** a month for some of the largest appraisal firms nationwide.

While building that out, we realized the root problem wasn’t tools - it was the appraisal workflow itself: subjective, opaque, and built for a workforce with a median age of 62.

With new top down regulation called UAD 3.6 coming in January and reshaping the entire reporting format & data guidelines, appraisals are about to experience its biggest reset in decades with **20% of the workforce retiring** and turn times set to expand from the current **5-7 day** average to **several week long**.

Here’s how an Automax appraisal works:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95483&key=user_uploads/1939136/5b40d57c-0f8b-45e3-a2a6-12cf719dc5a9)

Automax sends a certified inspector to scan the property with our mobile app- LiDAR and CV extract 150+ attributes: dimensions, condition, finishes, layout, and more.

# [**🕺**](https://emojipedia.org/man-dancing)**The Team**

[**Nolan (Founder & CEO)**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nolan-rossi/) – triple majored in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, Astrophysics, and Business Administration through UC Berkeley’s M.E.T. program, graduating in three years. He previously worked as a software development engineer at Amazon and ran a software consultancy he scaled to $250k in revenue. As a fourth-generation member of a family construction business, Nolan saw firsthand how difficult it is for contractors to consistently find new work — and how little time they have to sit down and bid on projects while managing active jobs. Scout Out was built to solve that problem.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/6d9cfed3-6baf-4fac-b9b7-ec2a2d99a6de)

# **❌ The Problem**

Residential contractors are running complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never built for construction.

* **Project management is fragmented.** Plans live in email. Estimates live in spreadsheets. Photos live on phones. Proposals get copy-pasted from old Word docs. Nothing talks to anything else.
* **Estimating is slow and error-prone.** Reading through plans, measuring takeoffs, pricing labor and materials, then assembling a professional proposal — this process takes hours and still produces mistakes. Contractors either underbid to win, or overbid to be safe, and lose anyway.
* **AI tools exist but aren't built for construction.** Generic project management software ignores the realities of field work — plan sets, per-page takeoffs, scope changes mid-build, subcontractor coordination.

  Contractors end up duct-taping tools together and paying the price in margin and stress.

**The result:** Jobs are won with incomplete bids, managed with ad-hoc systems, and closed with manual paperwork that eats hours contractors don't have.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/0cdecb42-5772-4e1d-81d1-1d7fb87db86d)

# **🙌 Our Solution: One Platform for the Entire Job**

Scout Out is a single platform that handles the full lifecycle of a construction job — from first estimate to final invoice — with AI doing the heavy lifting.

### Job & Customer Hub 🏗️

Everything lives in one place, organized around the job:

* Customer records and full contact history
* All uploads in one place: plans, photos, permits, contracts, and insurance
* Status tracking across every deliverable and milestone
* Every conversation, change order, and document tied to the right job

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/ffbb3afc-3a3e-425d-800a-23c7fc95413a)

### Instant AI-Powered Bidding ⚡

When a contractor finds a project they want, ScoutOut generates a **clean, editable quote in seconds**.

* Upload plans, photos, or a short description
* AI produces a structured estimate covering scope, labor, and materials
* Contractors can review, adjust, and send a professional bid immediately

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/cf8c8b3c-0744-4b8b-b092-16e0952bf102)

### Built for Real Contractor Workflows 🔧

ScoutOut is designed for how contractors actually work:

* No long setup or training
* Quotes are editable and contractor-owned
* Built to be used between site visits, calls, and active builds

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/f723d694-6721-4b5a-a80a-4bd39e691892)

launches.body:
### TL;DR

**Atlia is the AI-native short-term rental property management company.**

**You give us your Airbnbs to manage, and you’ll take home 10-20% more while both you and your guests have a better experience.**

Launch Video:\
<https://youtu.be/gvvV5zLIPV4>

## The Problem

Short-term rentals were sold as passive income. But in reality, every Airbnb is a tiny hotel and a nightmare of operations. Every reservation restarts the operational clock: prices must be adjusted, guests screened, messages answered, cleaners scheduled, access coordinated, supplies restocked, and maintenance handled, often overnight or between back-to-back stays.

And in traditional short-term property management companies, operational failures are common, and they can quickly become very costly:

* A missed cleaning becomes a bad review
* A poorly screened guest becomes property damage
* A neglected maintenance issue becomes an issued refund or lost booking

On top of these operational failures, the average management company takes 15–30% of rental revenue, often alongside cleaning, maintenance, and other fees.

We’ve been property managers for the past year and ran into the same lose-lose choice every owner faces: manage a 24/7 hospitality business yourself, or hand over a quarter of your revenue to a management company whose costs increase with every property it adds.

## The Solution

We are building a new type of property management company, with infrastructure built for agents and human-computer-interaction from the ground up. By replacing the layers of coordination and operational overhead built into traditional management companies, we provide a much better service at a much lower fee.

We center around a simple premise: owners shouldn’t have to choose between good service and reasonable fees. With our model, **owners take home 10–20% more and guests have a more premium experience.**

## Team

We’re Shaan and Edmond, longtime friends, Duke roommates, and property managers.

Edmond previously built AI voice agents at Rilla, LLM agents at S&P Global, and data pipelines at Vanguard. He has been managing rentals for a year, experiencing the owner’s dilemma firsthand.

Shaan previously designed GPU hardware at Apple, brain-computer interface research at Yale, computer architecture research at Duke. He also has been managing Airbnbs and longer-term rentals for a year and a half.

## The Ask

We are live in 80 properties today, and would love to have you join us.

**If you own a short-term rental** (such as an Airbnb), we can help you generate more revenue while providing better experiences to guests and giving you that peace of mind that your property is in good hands.

**If you are considering investing in a short-term rental,** we can help turn your investment into a much more lucrative investment vehicle.

You can reach out to us at [founders@atlia.com](mailto:founders@atlia.com). And schedule a free property review at [www.atlia.com](http://www.atlia.com).

launches.title: Rudus: AI-powered takeoff for concrete subcontractors
launches.tagline: Rudus helps concrete contractors produce quotes 80% faster
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Rudus is an AI-powered takeoff and estimation platform built for concrete subcontractors. Takeoff is the process of measuring and quantifying materials from concrete plan sheets. Rudus identifies every concrete structure (footings, walls, columns, slabs), pulls in related details, and eliminates hours of manual quantity calculation.

**Ask:** If you know anyone in construction, we would greatly appreciate a warm introduction. Concrete-specific would be even more amazing. We would also love to talk to anyone who has built computer vision models.

**Launch video**\
<<https://youtu.be/QdXKLNN4IQo> >

**The problem:**

Concrete subcontractors are the backbone of every building, and their estimating workflow hasn't changed in 20 years . A senior estimator opens a PDF, manually traces every footing and grade beam, then hand-builds an Excel spreadsheet with 300+ line items- volumes, formwork, rebar by bar size with lap splices and development lengths. One bid takes 20 to 40 hours. Most firms have just a few estimators. That means they physically cannot bid on most of the work available to them. 

The software incumbent in this trade hasn’t been updated since 2020. Past that, every AI takeoff tool on the market was built for GCs and treats concrete as one checkbox. None of them expand rebar assemblies. None of them compute development lengths. None of them output quantities the way a concrete estimator actually prices work. We built Rudus for this trade and only this trade. 

**Solution**

An estimator uploads their structural PDFs. Rudus auto-classifies every sheet (foundation plans, section details, footing schedules, frame elevations) and routes each to the right processing pipeline. Computer vision detects concrete elements across the drawing set and follows cross-references across sheets to resolve dimensions and detailing, catching elements that plan-only tools always miss. Each element gets expanded into full assembly line items: concrete, formwork, and rebar with all the calcs an estimator would normally do by hand. A typical foundation package goes from a handful of assemblies to 80-120 priced line items. The estimator reviews, overrides where needed, and exports straight into their existing workflow. We cut takeoff time by 80% and help estimators bid 3-5× more projects without adding headcount. From plan upload to bid package, every part of the workflow gets faster. 

**How we got here**

Sahil and I were engineers at Amazon and Airbnb respectively. We are both from Cupertino, CA and have been best friends since high school, always talking of starting a company together. Sahil took a construction management class and realized estimation workflows hadn't changed in decades. We started cold calling, walking into offices, showing up at job sites, and everyone told us the same thing: slow estimation is the biggest bottleneck in their business, but every new product they've tried has failed. We quickly realized that the reason those tools failed is a lack of trust. Estimators stake million to billion dollar bids on these numbers, and they won't trade their workflow for a black box. We took a different approach: software that accelerates their current workflows rather than replacing it by forward deploying our product into their current estimation workflow. The response from the industry was overwhelmingly positive, and we now ship weekly to estimators with decades of experience. They keep asking for more.

**Y Combinator Launch**

We’re Marguerite and Paul, we left robotics research at MIT and Harvard to build AquaShield. AquaShield is a water damage prevention system built for large real estate portfolios.

We started building this solution on MIT campus, with the facilities team and are now working with one of the largest residential portfolios in the world. 

**The Problem** 

Water damage is the biggest preventable loss in real estate, more than fire and theft combined.

Real estate portfolios lose up to hundreds of millions in water damage each year. They rely on reactive maintenance. Most water leaks are only discovered by tenant complaints, visual signs or water-bill spikes. 

Pipes are hard to monitor because they are mostly inaccessible, buried in drywall and concrete.

**The Solution**

We solve that problem with non-invasive sensors, strategically placed, and ML algorithms that can find the leak in noisy water consumption patterns and localize the source, down to the pipe segment. $100k+ remediation jobs turn into sub-$2k targeted fixes.

**The result:** ​​portfolio-wide protection. Each building is protected for a fraction of the cost of a single major claim.

If you own or operate a real estate portfolio, we'd love to show you what this looks like in your buildings. Book a demo: [aquashieldai.com](http://aquashieldai.com)

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're Kyle and Kevin, co-founders of CentralComs.

### **TLDR:**

[CentralComs](https://centralcoms.com/) is an **AI receptionist and after-hours answering service** for home service businesses like **HVAC, plumbing, and electrical** companies. It answers the calls your office misses, books the appointment into your existing schedule, and then keeps following up on new leads, open estimates, and past customers until they book. **More of the leads you already pay for turn into jobs.**

<https://youtu.be/iXSZrThZFOs>

### **The Problem ❌**

**Home service companies spend heavily to make the phone ring, then lose a chunk of that revenue before a technician ever shows up.**

When the office is busy or closed:

* After-hours and overflow calls go to voicemail
* New leads sit for hours before anyone calls back
* Open estimates never get a follow-up
* Past customers are never reactivated
* CSRs work callback lists by hand
* Post-job happy calls happen only when someone remembers

The expensive part, generating demand, already happened. **The hard part is turning it into booked work.**

Most tools fix one piece. Answering services take messages. VAs and extra CSRs add capacity, but they cost a lot to scale and rarely cover 24/7. Generic AI receptionists answer the phone and stop there.

### **Solution ✅**

**Part 1: AI receptionist and after-hours answering, 24/7**

When your office can't pick up, CentralComs does. It answers after-d calls, figures out what the customer needs, qualifies the lead,answers routine questions, and **books the appointment into the schedule you already use**. It handles confirmations and reschedules, and it hands off any conversation that needs a human.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114503&key=user_uploads/1562583/82afad82-dec9-4460-b4f4-71c18fb5e736)

It works alongside the systems your team already uses, so you don'tont office gets 24/7 capacity without another hire.

**Part 2: Automated lead follow-up and customer reactivation**

Booking the first call is only the start. CentralComs keeps working customer hangs up:

* **Speed-to-lead** follow-up on new inquiries
* **Follow-up on estimates** that haven't closed
* **Intent gauging**: ready to book, still deciding, or no longer inter
* **Lead nurture** sequences
* **Appointment reminders** and confirmations
* Post-job **happy calls**
* **Past-customer reactivation** and recontact for future service

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114503&key=user_uploads/1562583/0331287a-0195-4998-ac9a-ef4b065e3052)

No CSR has to remember every callback, open quote, and old customer the agent more context on your services, business rules, and customers, so it handles more routine communication over time and passes the judgment calls back to your team.

### **Our Team**

We're Kyle and Kevin, former UC Berkeley students and longtime AI builders. Kyle previously built and scaled an AI facility-management platform to **$600K ARR**, used by teams at **NVIDIA, Cushman & Wakefield, and NASA JPL**. Kev at a venture-backed startup, where he scaled agentic infrastructure to **40,000+ concurrent users** and later built AI video-generation technology that generated **$XX,XXX in its first month**.

launches.body:
# 

---

Hey everyone 👋

We’re Kyle and Kevin; co-founders of CentralComs. We’re children of landlords and are building a solution to a problem we saw all throughout our childhoods.

**TL;DR**

We run property management workflows such as **leasing, back office, and maintenance coordination workflows from start to finish,** so PM teams run smoother and earn more with the same team size.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A3NjiCcbBNY>

### **The Problem**

Property management operations are relentless, high-stakes, hands-on work built on relationships with owners, tenants, and vendors that take years to earn and seconds to lose.

It's overwhelmingly manual: **roughly 90% of the work is still manual** and extremely labor-intensive with **89% of property management companies outsourcing work** to teams overseas.

About half of leasing inquiries come in at night and on weekends, when no one's answering. **Conversion drops 7x after the first hour**.

Unresolved work orders are a top reason tenants don't renew, and **every lost renewal costs thousands** once you count turn and vacancy.

The work is rules-based and repetitive, but it demands constant attention, and missing any single step breaks the chain. That's why these roles scale so badly with headcount— you're paying for someone to be awake at the right moment to do menial tasks.

---

## **Our Solution**

**Maintenance Coordination Agent** Takes a maintenance request from submission to resolution:

* **Intake across any channel** — captures requests from email, SMS, and tenant portals, normalizing them into a single queue
* **Intelligent triage** — applies a proprietary relative and objective scoring algorithm to prioritize and triage issues in real time as conditions change
* **Smart dispatch** — routes to the right vendor based on trade, availability, and cost, sends the dispatch, and tracks confirmation
* **Persistent follow-up** — chases vendors, tenants, and owners intelligently until the job is on track and on schedule
* **Repair verification** — confirms work was actually completed via tenant sign-off, photo evidence, and vendor confirmation before closing the loop
* **Invoice processing** — validates invoices against the scope of work and approved estimates, flags discrepancies, and routes for payment approval
* **Owner & tenant updates** — keeps all parties informed at each milestone without manual outreach

**Leasing Agent** Takes a prospect from first inquiry to complete application:

* **Cross channel intake** — captures leads from listing syndication, email, SMS, web forms, and phone, normalizing them into a single queue
* **Intelligent qualification** — applies a proprietary relative and objective scoring algorithm to qualify and prioritize prospects in real time as new information comes in
* **Smart routing** — matches each lead to the right unit, schedules the tour, sends the application, and tracks completion
* **Document analysis** — reviews submitted IDs, pay stubs, and bank statements, flagging income, completeness, and inconsistencies against your criteria
* **Verification & screening** — runs identity verification and background/credit screening, then compiles a clean, decision-ready file
* **Persistent follow-up** — chases prospects intelligently until they're marked qualified

**What makes us different than traditional PMS systems?**

* We handle can handle edge cases proactively, asking for more information, reading documents, and determining the best course of action
* We don’t automate reply drafts, we send out messages, dispatch calls, retrieve missing information, and push stalled work-orders or application processes to completion.

---

## **Our Ask**

**If you answer "yes" to any of these, we'd love your help:**

* Do you know any residential property management operators whose teams are stretched thin, managing multiple systems just to keep up with maintenance and leasing?
* Do you know any property management companies looking to scale operations without increased labor cost?

**Contact**

Reach us at [**founders@centralcoms.com**](mailto:founders@centralcoms.com) or schedule a demo today at[ ](http://atlance.live/)[**centralcoms.com**](http://centralcoms.com)

launches.body:
Real estate does not have an AI problem. It has an infrastructure problem.

While nearly every major industry is using AI to move faster, reduce manual work, and automate operations, real estate agents are still managing some of the largest financial transactions in the world through disconnected software, email threads, repetitive data entry, and paperwork.

Agents should be spending their time winning clients, advising buyers and sellers, and closing deals. Instead, they lose hours gathering property information, filling out the same details across multiple forms, tracking deadlines, and coordinating every party involved in a transaction.

That is why we are building RealPact.

RealPact is not another tool for completing one form or managing one part of a deal. We are building the intelligent transaction infrastructure for real estate agents and brokerages: a system that can understand a transaction, automate the paperwork, coordinate every party, track every deadline, and carry a deal from the first conversation to closing.

Most real estate software stores the work. RealPact does the work.\
\
<https://youtu.be/cT0B-YNwN34>

We are already working with several major brokerages in New Hampshire and rolling out RealPact across their teams.

“RealPact feels magical. We have never seen anything like it in real estate, and we believe it is going to change the industry for good.”

Spenser Molloy\
Owner, NextHome Modern Realty

Our long-term vision is simple: give every real estate agent an intelligent operating system that handles the transaction work behind the scenes, so they can spend more time building relationships, serving clients, and closing deals.

launches.title: Alloovium - Automating compliance for major construction projects
launches.tagline: Turning everything your project produces into answers you can trust and compliance you can prove.
launches.body:
# \*\*\*\*

**TL;DR: Alloovium automates compliance for major construction projects 🚧** Construction is 13% of global GDP, and it runs on paperwork. Nobody in the industry wants another platform — they want what they already have brought together in one place. Alloovium is that unifying layer: it reads everything the project produces from the tools you already use, and turns it into cited answers you can trust and the documentation that moves the job forward — compliant with the builder's own management system, every answer cited to its source sentence, a human sign-off on anything AI-drafted.

[**https://youtu.be/wVPJL3o8PzM**](https://youtu.be/wVPJL3o8PzM)

**🚧 The problem**

On major projects, the record keeps losing: 80% of megaprojects blow their budget or schedule, and sums in dispute average a third of contract budgets. We think the root cause is hiding in plain sight — in the paperwork.

**The root cause:** paperwork is a state in time — every document a snapshot of a project thats moving daily. The documents aren't a pile, they're a web: the safety plan leans on procedures; procedures lean on templates, registers and licences; and the tender made promises all of them have to keep true. Across every company delivering the job. People spend their days dragging the paper back to reality instead of moving the job forward.

**The consequence:** one change means five documents to amend, and nobody catches the missed one until an auditor, regulator or client's lawyer does. In some jurisdictions: up to 25 years jail for directors and a $20M fine for the GC.

**The cost of coping:** engineers who trained for years to build spend their days chasing paper instead. One tier-1 team is spending $2.5M and 40–50 people on a single 400-page submission of management plans — and that's before the project even starts.

**The unlock:** a sleepless project sentinel, keeping watch on the documented rules, unlocking the experts to focus on the build.

**🔨 What Alloovium does**

* **Documents, Apps, Correspondence and Conversations centralised in the Project.** A singular place where the project becomes a reality.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105028&key=user_uploads/3047254/69afa2af-4a4e-4376-ad5e-186084b42ee4)

* **Cited answers over every project document.** Click the citation, land on the exact source sentence.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105028&key=user_uploads/3047254/6687ff2d-1620-404b-b4a9-a6f8a8fd5aae)

* **Routines.** Build repeatable workflows that are triggered by on-site events to always stay ahead of the game on your paperwork.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105028&key=user_uploads/3047254/ec46815c-e232-43eb-a583-ec74c80f25ff)

* **Drafting from the project itself.** Call transcript to a formatted and actionable document in minutes, with AI-authorship tracking, a human still refines and reviews it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105028&key=user_uploads/3047254/503df904-c919-46e3-9e31-c3e2c768db67)

* **Continual compliance sweeps** against the builder's own IMS, clause by clause. Our new engine's first end-to-end sweep landed **39 cited findings** on one project.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105028&key=user_uploads/3047254/fd973fc4-a947-4f2a-8e9c-d2e42671b97f)

* Plus meeting/inbox capture, voice to text data capture, licence-expiry alerts, and live SharePoint + Procore sync.

**📈 Traction**

Deploying across $400M in active projects, including a subsidiary of BMD (one of Australia's largest privately owned civil contractors). ISO compliance product in beta with a 30-year auditor as design partner.

**👋 Who we are**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105028&key=user_uploads/3047254/aba0a4bb-7496-4a42-960f-bb96be1c8307)

* [**Zander Schweitzer**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/3047254) grew up in construction, spent his fifth birthday in the back of a bulldozer, drove dump trucks, and worked as a site engineer before quitting to start this.
* [@Cielo Nicolosi](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/3650351) has coded since he was 8, was founding engineer at four startups, placed top 0.25% of his state, and won Australia's largest student hackathon.
* Around us: an exited construction-tech founder, an ex-LexisNexis Senior Data Scientist, and a founding SDR from Askable.

**⭐️ Our ask**

* **Intros** to construction, engineering, or AEC, especially head contractors, GCs, or ENR Top 400 firms in the US. Construction is structurally viral (one head contractor exposes us to \~50 subs a year), so one warm intro compounds.

* **Notes** if you've sold software into archaic industries.

Drop me a note at [zander@alloovium.com](mailto:zander@alloovium.com), +61 438 965 455 or direct any friends to <https://www.alloovium.com/en/innovation-partner>

launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re David and Michael, co-founders of FlowManual.

**What FlowManual is**: AI preconstruction for General and MEP contractors, executing projects while cutting risk. 

**TL;DR:** Construction contractors waste hundreds of hours monthly on manual tasks, sifting through 500-page PDFs only to miss fine print that can cost tens of thousands. FlowManual automates the back-office work before and during construction, so teams can reliably secure and complete projects faster than ever before.

<https://youtu.be/aO5fBj_3kpU>\
\
**The Problem:**

Meet Jeremy. He’s a project manager at a mid-sized contractor, and his job is to secure projects and then make sure the company doesn’t lose money on already thin margins.

A bid invite lands in his inbox. To put together one number his firm can send in, Jeremy has to read thousands of pages. A 400-page project manual, drawings, insurance, spec sections, and so much more. Buried somewhere inside all this print is a line that can ultimately decide whether this job makes or loses money. From a liquidated-damages clause to a scope item sneakily handed to the mechanical contractor, if Jeremy misses it, it’s a $5K-$10K mistake.

Jeremy’s got one week, three other bids on his desk, and no way to read all of it as carefully as he’d like. So he reads what he can and sends in a number.

Say he wins. A change in the signed contract by the General Contractor or a sneaky difference in vendor pricing costs the company thousands after the fact. Every step of the way requires hundreds of pages of reading and referencing done under a deadline. And Jeremy does this for every job.

**The Solution:**\
FlowManual automates these historical workflows that contractors run on, allowing teams to submit bids and complete projects faster than ever before. Here’s a couple major features:

* AI Takeoffs from drawings
* Drawing comparisons / overlay
* Bid leveling
* Contract Review

Our software doesn’t do the job for you, but it works alongside you to reduce time spent and mistakes made.

**About Us:**\
Michael and David were college roommates and engineers at Harvard. When renovations for a heater in our dorm took 6 weeks, we poked at the problem, realizing it stems from a larger issue. Through hundreds of conversations with professionals, we found an industry that ran on file cabinets, Excel, and page-by-page manual review.\
\
**Our Ask:**

* **Know anyone in construction?** Connections to anyone in the industry, including on the legal and tech side, is greatly appreciated. Anyone in Project Management, Business Development, Marketing, IT are ideal! Reach us at [founders@flowmanual.com](mailto:founders@flowmanual.com)

launches.tagline: We allow title shops to close more deals
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Title insurance is the thorn in the side of every single residential real estate transaction in America. With the home market bleeding, you'll find attorneys processing documents by hand with outdated software at title agencies. Vestris automates the back office and supplements processors the way software should — _letting shops give the same care to closing the biggest purchase of a buyer's life._

<https://youtu.be/u2do97AOvQY?si=JB78OAx5hDp80PXT>

### The Problem

Imagine you're shopping the market and you just found your dream home. You're ready to purchase, the contract is signed, everything is in place.

And you're recommended a settlement company, and told to buy title insurance.

Most homeowners couldn't tell you what title insurance actually buys them. In a nutshell: **you're paying for the peace of mind that the property you're buying has no open claims against it** — payments a title company makes on your behalf.

But it's also a process that takes weeks. Behind the phone, you've got lawyers processing files, manually checking emails, and scanning two seemingly identical documents for changes.

Meanwhile, the incumbent software is a decade-old, per-file database whose premium plans put it out of reach for the small and mid-size shops that make up most of the market.

### The Solution

Vestris runs the file end to end:

**Reads everything on arrival** — every document that hits a processor's inbox is routed to the right order, new contracts spin up new files, and the routine back-and-forth is handled, so the first 30% of a file is done before a human even looks.

**Does the math** — logs into county tax and land portals to pull up-to-date figures, then prorates taxes, utilities, HOA dues, and special assessments to the settlement date on that county's convention, every figure traced back to its source.

**Drafts the commitment** — building Schedule A from the vesting and legal description and Schedule B from the exceptions in the record, the work a small shop waits a week and pays an abstractor hundreds for.

**Closes it out** — reconciling the closing disclosure against the settlement statement, handling the lender back-and-forth, and showing the processor exactly what changed, so no one's squinting at two seemingly identical PDFs.

Every step still goes through human approval. What changes is bandwidth: **a mom-and-pop shop never has to turn down an order because they're swamped**, and they get to spend their time on the in-person care that made buyers seek them out in the first place.

### The Team

We're Aahil and Josh, best friends and UMich roommates.

Aahil previously built SafeKids and holds three USPTO patents. He spent the summer closing files at a title shop, seeing the processor's grind firsthand.

Josh previously built live-telemetry and communication systems for Michigan's Formula SAE team. He worked the same title desk, and stole the cubicle with the monitor 😠

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109429&key=user_uploads/3411947/af48be0b-23b2-4cb5-9c1c-4eb5c7b45e50)

### Our Ask

We're running Vestris in parallel at a title shop that settles millions in deals a month.

If you know anyone at **a title agency, escrow, or settlement company** — we'd love an intro.

And if you've ever bought or sold a home, reach out! You probably have strong feelings about the title process :)

You can reach us at [founders@vestris.ai](mailto:founders@vestris.ai), or better yet, give us a call at +1 (571) 466 7878.

launches.title: SubVysion: Preventing $150B is wasted construction spending
launches.tagline: Autonomous rovers building the 'Google Maps' of subsurface infrastructure
launches.body:
<https://youtu.be/5IY3vHEJ7J4>

Construction has a mapping problem. Of the $2.2T in annual US construction spending, $150B is wasted due to a lack of subsurface knowledge. All construction starts from the ground up, and more often than not, unexpected assets underneath the surface will hold a construction project back. Whether it's an unknown utility line, unexpected rock layer, or old foundation that wasn’t on any design map, the costs of delays from underground conflicts quickly add up. 

Take utility strikes, when an excavator hits an active utility line. For every dollar spent on the explicit repair cost of that utility line itself, the contractor loses an additional $30 per repair-dollar in project delays, insurance claims, idle work crews, and increased insurance premiums. For a hyperscale project such as data center construction, a single day of delay can cost the cloud-provider up to $14 million dollars for that single day.

In metropolitan areas, maps are incomplete at best and none create a unified picture of critical infrastructure, making excavation especially dangerous when natural gas or electric lines are broken.

Enter SubVysion. We’ve built a fleet of autonomous rovers carrying ground-penetrating radar and other sensors that create a centimeter-accurate map of subsurface infrastructure. Our hardware is the first and the best to map the entirety of US infrastructure. Using our rovers, we comprehensively map construction sites, city streets, and even larger indoor buildings, at 100x better granularity and 10x the speed (with a single rover) compared to our competitors. We process vast amounts of data using machine learning and agents, and output that data into an easy-to-understand 3D scene. 

Who are we? Maxwell Stone was an early ML engineer at Roboflow (YC S20), and Wenson Tang built the world’s smallest and cheapest LiDAR-capable drone for adverse environments. We both studied computer science at the University of Pennsylvania. Together, we’re building SubVysion to map the entirety of America’s subsurface infrastructure.

We’re currently on job sites in Philadelphia and Texas, helping our first market of utility contractors save hundreds of thousands of dollars every year. We’re soon to expand our mapping services to municipalities and energy providers as we scale up our rover fleet and capacity!

If you’re in the energy, infrastructure, or hyperscale construction world, we’d love to hear from you at [founders@subvysion.com](mailto:founders@subvysion.com)!
